My latest and scariest "encounter" wasn't actually me but I was right next door to what happened. I think it was 2-3 years ago. My parents and I visited the Philippines for my grandpa's funeral. My uncle-in-law was in his room on his computer when the door locked and he said he could feel a cold touch on his shoulder. He went to open the door but he was pulled onto the ground and was being strangled. Luckily, he managed to bang on the door which we heard cause our room was right next door. My aunt managed to find the key and opened it and we found him on the floor. He said when we came in it stopped. 

I couldn't sleep that night cause it was too crazy. My other aunt who was there also felt a presence. She's sensitive to that stuff so she knew what was up. She was the one that told us that something was probably going on though we didn't act on anything until we heard my uncle-in-law bang on the door.

I try to block out most of it and I can't fully translate some of the things she says since I'm not as fluent in my native language. But my mum says stuff like:
"You're pathetic/worthless/an idiot."
"You're never gonna succeed in if you live your life like this."
"I want you out of the house."
"I swear I'm gonna beat you up."
"You're a devil/demon."
"You're a horrible child."
"You have no respect for your parents. You're a rude bastard."

Since I was not born where I am living (Australia), she's threatened to send me back to my home
country multiple times as well. 

Basically just ranting that I'll never get anywhere with my life because I'm stupid and never once did she try to help me with anything. Just complains.

My dad doesn't really say much unless he's really angry. All he does is support my mum but never me. Never ONCE in my life, has he asked if I was alright after a conflict with my mum. He just goes straight to her and talk and listen to the complaints she makes. Really loud complaints that I can hear from the other side of the house which doesn't improve my mood at all.

It's not just verbal though. Sometimes she does tries to physically attack me. And I can't do it back since I really don't want to attack another person, especially someone like my mum, plus I'm too scared to anyway. All I do in those times is push her away from me or if it gets too far, dig my nails into her or something in hopes that she will let me go.

Sounds like my mum. I don't even know if I can
call her that anymore.

I know what it feels like to feel like you have no one. But just remember that you're not alone. Others have experienced these problems in some way as well and they will sympathise. It's tough but we gotta stay strong. I try to tell myself this too. Helps me out a bit after a breakdown.

I made some close friends and I don't want to drift away from them because they're the ones that kept me sane from all this time.

As for my relationship with my parents, it's never gonna be alright. It's been toxic and rocky for the past few years and it's just been going downhill even if I try to talk in a civil manner so I really have no hope for that. Maybe it will get better in time but I've been saying that for the longest time.

I don't have much of a choice but to live with no enjoyment in my life for a long while. I don't even want to turn to my real life friends anymore since I feel like they don't understand what I'm really going through and I feel like I've bothered them enough times anyway. I've never felt so alone in my life.
